purpose: Wave-4 CRITICAL ironman permanent tools still missing as first-class rows in data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json (359-record audit). Targets travel infrastructure, Prayer AFK stack pieces, Invention drop cleaner, All Fired Up adze equipment, Karamja TokKul-Zo, Abyss magical-thread supply package, DG resource-dungeon unlock map, individual crystal gather tools (pick/hatchet/mattock), Croesus seed bag, and high-value modified skill-outfit heads. Complements wave3-missing + other wave4 enrichments without re-emitting ids already present in research.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed absent from regional-skilling-unlocks.json: fairy ring, Ava chain, bonecrusher necklace stack, attuned ectoplasmator, spring cleaner, inferno adze equipment, TokKul-Zo, magical-thread package, resource-dungeon unlock package, crystal pick/hatchet/mattock equipment, seed bag, modified farmer/botanist heads. SKIP: asgarnia:wicked-hood and multi-region:poh-gilded-altar (pending wave4-slayer-rc-prayer); cross-region:fired-up-inferno-adze-chain stack (pending wave4-cross-stacks — this file adds the missing equipment row only); kandarin:modified-diviners-headwear (pending wave4-diaries-outfits); forinthry:abyss-runecrafting-stack (pending — this file adds thread-supply package that links sword+abyss); individual resource dungeons already filed (mining-guild, edimmu, and wave4 edgeville/karamja volcano).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change travel, Prayer AFK, inventory QoL, gather tools, or RC pouch economy.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, and effects only.
policy.rs3_terminology: RS3 has no fused 'bonecrusher necklace' craft item (OSRS). Stack = bonecrusher + demon horn necklace (Daemonheim Rewards). Ava top tier is alerter (not alethiometer).
